o4Result.reason: A PIT-safe opponent-strength adjustment requires each prior game's OPPONENT quality as of THAT prior game's own date (a per-game, per-date snapshot lookup), not the opponent's season-final quality -- that lookup structure does not exist yet and building it honestly is substantial new engineering outside tonight's scope. Recommend as a separately preregistered follow-up experiment rather than an improvised design here.
